name: Mango sticky rice
description: Warm coconut sticky rice with ripe mango and a salty coconut pour.

tcm.note: Sticky rice is warm; the mango and coconut cool it.

ayurveda.note: Ripe mango is ushna in the classical reading.

unani.note: Aam is garam-tar in desi usage.

nutrition.highlight: the salty pour is the point
